system.description: Through your relationship with the spirit shard, you can learn the names of ancient beings of power, gaining the ability to summon and commune with them — dragons, demons, perhaps even clan Methuselahs — though since no control is granted, you had best have something to offer before you call. Expend three Blood Traits, allowing them to bleed into the ground over half an hour to appease the spirit shard's thirst. At the end, win a Static Mental Challenge, difficulty determined by the Storyteller based on what you wish to summon (perhaps reduced by a Trait if you have summoned it before). The being arrives before the end of the scene; the Storyteller assigns whatever statistics and needs she deems appropriate, and most will want to be satiated before listening to your concerns. Creatures summoned this way remain until slain or they choose to leave.
